name: Academic Research Skills
description: Academic research enhancement suite: verify DOI metadata and citation counts via Crossref to prevent academic hallucinations, perform structured literature analysis, and assist with peer-review evaluation. Ready to use with no private API key required.
whenToUse: Use during literature review, academic writing, citation verification, or manuscript peer review. Quickly verify DOI authenticity, extract publication metadata, analyze argumentation chains, and simulate peer reviews.

verify_doi.description: Verify paper DOIs via the Crossref API to validate literature authenticity, extract titles, authors, journals, publication years, citation counts, and abstracts to prevent academic hallucinations. No API key required.

academic_paper_analysis.description: Structured literature analysis tool: decompose abstracts, methodology, or key arguments across multiple dimensions (objectives, hypotheses, methods, evidence chains, and limitations) to streamline research notes.

peer_review_evaluation.description: Academic peer review assistant: evaluate scientific manuscripts against international publication standards, producing structured critique rubrics, major/minor revision notes, and review recommendations.
